resources.string: Videos, music and your favourite channels, together in one app. Search, follow channels, save playlists and download content for offline playback. Let’s set it up together — no technical knowledge needed.
Follow a channel to find its new videos here. You can refresh the list, filter by channel and manage your subscriptions.

Search videos, channels, and playlists
Tap the “%1$s” tab below the search box to see matching channels. If there are no results, try a more specific name.
Tap the channel you want to follow in the results. Its page will open.
A profile for each source?

You can keep YouTube and Spotify separate, each with its own history, playlists and colour. The main profile will be hidden, not deleted. Existing content from eligible profiles will be copied to the matching source profile. YouTube and Spotify profiles cannot be deleted and each uses only its own source.

Private profiles and profiles protected by PIN or device authentication are excluded. Their data stays where it is. Existing logins from unprotected profiles are reused when available; the current profile takes priority.
Yes, separate YouTube and Spotify
No, keep my current profiles
Choose other source profiles
YouTube and Spotify are included. You can also create dedicated profiles for the sources below. Existing source profiles are already selected.
Completed downloads are reused without downloading the files again. The originals stay in their original profiles.
Create profiles and organise my library
Separate source profiles are ready.
Preparing profiles: %1$d/%2$d
Finish or cancel the current imports and downloads before organising profiles.
Profiles could not be prepared. Your original data has not been removed.
Install the selected sources first from Prefs → Sources, then try again.
The destination profiles are protected. Open an unprotected profile before continuing.
An original profile was protected or removed during preparation. The pending copies have not been activated; your original data is safe.
This profile is dedicated to one source. You can sign in or update it, but cannot remove it or add other sources here.
Help is always close by

On the Home screen, tap the question mark in a circle at the top left. “How do I…?” guides you through searching, playlists, downloads and following channels. You can reopen this setup using the wizard-hat icon next to it.
Change source profile
Switch between your separate source profiles. Each keeps its own library, login and colour.
Tap the profile icon at the top right of Home to see the available profiles.

Choose the source profile you want. You can also swipe left or right on the profile icon in Home to cycle through profiles; protected profiles are skipped. To open a protected profile, select it here and unlock it.
